The dataset fields of the five survey files

Source: R/wizard-step_status.R
survey_fields.Rd

The names of the dataset fields the Survey Files step fills, one per survey file. Each has built-in data for the dataset's country, so cache()$is_default(field) is the way to tell whether the user has uploaded a file for it.

Usage

survey_fields

Format

A character vector of five field names: "national_survey", "regional_survey", "wiq_survey" (wealth index quintiles), "area_survey" and "education_survey".

Examples

survey_fields
#> [1] "national_survey"  "regional_survey"  "wiq_survey"       "area_survey"     
#> [5] "education_survey"

# which survey files the user has uploaded
cache <- load_cache_data(system.file("extdata", "kenya.xlsx", package = "cd2030.core"))
#> ℹ Loading Excel "kenya.xlsx" for parts
#> ! The following columns are empty: anc_1trimester, under5_deaths, total_deaths,
#>   ipv2, measles_cases
#> ℹ Successfully loaded and cleaned data
#> ℹ Auto-detect candidates (|group|): vaccine=19, rmncah=28 -> selected rmncah
vapply(survey_fields, function(f) !cache$is_default(f), logical(1))
#>  national_survey  regional_survey       wiq_survey      area_survey 
#>            FALSE            FALSE            FALSE            FALSE 
#> education_survey 
#>            FALSE
